faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Cryogenic Tank Clamp Band suitable for Propellant tank clamp band (Ti-5Al-2.5Sn ELI)?
faq.a: Titanium Cryogenic Tank Clamp Band uses Ti-5Al-2.5Sn ELI because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address cryogenic hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Cryogenic Tank Clamp Band?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Cryogenic Tank Clamp Band require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. cryogenic hardware components receive Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Cryogenic Tank Clamp Band shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.
